title: Eastside
summary: Two adults look back at the shape of a teenage love that outgrew them.

title: Remember That Night?
summary: You thought you were over it, then one memory pulls you back under.

title: Ordinary
summary: If we only have this life, then loving you is the ceremony.

title: Duniyaa
translation: I'll call you into my streets today, my love / build a separate world with you / let no distance come between us / just spend a lifetime together.
summary: Let's build a small world where nothing outside can reach us.

title: I Like Me Better
summary: I'm a better version of myself when I'm with you.

title: Pinga
translation: Spin, girl, spin / my anklets are calling / the night is enchanting / spin till dawn.
summary: Two women dance out what they can't say in words.

title: Sunday Best
summary: Every day is a Sunday when you decide to feel good.

title: Pal Pal
translation: Every moment is hard to live without you / all intoxications useless without your eyes / I wait outside your door / come into my dreams dressed up.
summary: Every second without you is a second I can't survive.

title: Leja Re
translation: Don't go far / stay near / I'm crazy for you / take me away, take me away.
summary: Take me with you — I've given up trying to stay put.

title: Qatal
translation: Oh girl, your eyes are murder / they kill a hundred thousand / when you move, they kill again / you slaughter people just by looking.
summary: Her glance is a loaded gun and everyone she looks at is a corpse.

title: Rang De Basanti
artist: A.R. Rahman, Daler Mehndi, K.S. Chithra
translation: A little dust of my land, my country / fragrance from an intoxicating breeze / heaving breath / drops of red blood full of passion — colour me in that spring / martyr's saffron.
summary: Paint me in the colour of dust, blood, and sacrifice of this land.

title: Night Changes
summary: You'll change, everything will, but I'll still be here.

title: Baarishein
translation: Gently, softly take me in your arms / into your soft breath, your sighs / come close, we're both sitting here / between our hearts there is rain / on your words alone, the pouring builds.
summary: Sit close — the rain between us has been building a while.

title: Sooraj Dooba Hain
translation: Be a little selfish / why do you always listen to the world / listen to yourself sometimes / let something go wrong / let the heart get lost / let the heartbeat run free.
summary: The sun is down — now finally live for yourself.

title: Not Today
translation: All the underdogs / a day may come when we lose / but it is not today / one day flowers will fall / but no, not today / today is still too good to die.
summary: We'll lose eventually — but not today, not yet, keep going.

title: luther
summary: If I owned everything, I'd spend it all making your life bigger.

title: Counting Stars
summary: I'd rather lose sleep chasing what matters than count money that doesn't.

title: I Ain't Worried
summary: Time's short — I'm not going to waste it worrying.

title: They Don't Care About Us
summary: They said the truth about us, but we know they never cared.

title: Oorum Blood
translation: You are wave, you are forest rain / hey dude, not that / whatever they do I'll do the same / your town, your blood, a ten-thousand aura you carry / how many years of pain you've endured.
summary: My town and my blood — I stand with you through anything.

title: What Makes You Beautiful
summary: You're beautiful — you just don't see it, and that's the point.

title: Faded
summary: Where are you now — you've become a ghost I can't find.

title: Phir Bhi Tumko Chaahunga
translation: You are mine in this moment / tomorrow may not be the same / paths may separate / walking, we may lose each other / but I'll still love you.
summary: Even if we lose each other, I'll still love you.

title: Heat Waves
summary: You're all I think about even as we're falling apart.

title: Love Me Like You Do
summary: You are everything to me — touch me in the way only you can.

title: New Rules
summary: I've made rules for myself so I don't fall for him again.

title: Jugnu
translation: When you're not near I can't breathe properly / I feel irritable, nothing seems special / since I started dying for you there's no hope of surviving / in life…
summary: Without you nothing feels alive — you're the firefly in my night.

title: One Time
summary: Give me one chance — I'll love you the right way.

title: How Long
summary: I messed up — how long have you known, and can you forgive?

title: Mella Mellaga
translation: Slowly, softly you spilled a new colour in my heart / gently you spread like intoxication in my eyes / one moment is the whole truth / half of me is drifting apart / what is this…
summary: You've slowly coloured every corner of me, and I didn't notice until it was done.

title: A Thousand Years
summary: I've waited forever for you, and I'd wait a thousand more.

title: Roar
summary: I kept quiet too long — now watch me roar.

title: End of Beginning
summary: That version of me in Chicago — I'll never quite be him again.

title: Sunday Best (alt)
summary: Every day is a Sunday when you decide to feel good.

title: One Thing
summary: I don't know what it is about you — but it's something.

title: Kiss You
summary: Tell me you want to, and I'll take you anywhere.

title: One Less Lonely Girl
summary: I'll make sure there's one less lonely girl in the world — you.

title: Stitches
summary: Your words cut me open — I need stitches, or someone to breathe me back.

title: Boyfriend
summary: If I were your boyfriend, I'd never let you go.

title: Cold Water
summary: You won't drown alone — I'll be your cold water when you need it.

title: Love Yourself
summary: You should go and love yourself — that's clearly your favourite subject.

title: willow
summary: You pulled me under like water — I'll follow you wherever you bend.

title: good 4 u
summary: Good for you — must be nice to feel nothing at all.

title: thank u, next
summary: Every ex taught me something — thanks, next chapter.

title: You Need To Calm Down
summary: You're taking shots at everyone — you need to calm down.

title: Savage Love (BTS Remix)
translation: (Korean bridges roughly) Even though you're savage, I still want you / your love hurts, but I'll take it.
summary: You look like an angel and love like a knife — and I want more.

title: like JENNIE
translation: (Korean lines roughly) Look at me — this is my edition, no one else's / you can't copy this.
summary: There's a way to do it 'like JENNIE' — and no one else can.

title: Unstoppable
summary: I'm unstoppable — even if the armour is holding me together.

title: Rap God
summary: I'm the rap god — nobody's touching this speed or this résumé.

title: Believer
summary: The pain made me a believer — every hit built the person you see now.

title: Ik Vaari Aa
translation: Come once, dear / come once / I keep watching the road, helpless / evening is falling / this heart is in your name.
summary: Just come once — that's all I'm asking.

title: I Knew You Were Trouble
summary: I saw the warning signs, walked in anyway, and here I am.

title: Shivers
summary: You give me shivers — everything about you goes straight through me.

title: Bad Habits
summary: Bad habits start at night — and you're the worst one I keep.

title: Sucker
summary: I'm a sucker for you — that's the whole story.

title: Company
translation: So what's the company saying / are we conscious or not / everyone here — what a shot / Emiway bantai / and remember the company folks / take it forward again…
summary: The company's up — everyone here knows why we hustle.

title: Thinking Out Loud
summary: When we're old and worn out — I'll still love you the same.

title: Mood
summary: Why are you always in a mood — I'm out.

title: Without Me
summary: I built you up — you couldn't have done any of it without me.

title: Blinding Lights
summary: I'm chasing you through the city at night, and I can't stop.

title: Beautiful People
themes: staying yourself in a glamorous crowd
summary: They're beautiful people — but we don't need to be.

title: I'm Good (Blue)
summary: I'm good, I'm blue — I'm going to have the best night of my life.

title: Seven
translation: (Korean bridges roughly) With you every day of the week / all night long.
summary: I want you every day of the week, from morning through night.

title: Thunder
summary: They laughed at my dreams — now they hear the thunder.

title: Love Don't Hate It
summary: I wasn't ready — but love, don't hate me for being scared.

title: Arcade
themes: heartbreak as arcade you keep losing at
carrying pieces of a broken heart
summary: Loving you was a losing game I kept playing anyway.

title: Circles
summary: We keep running in circles — maybe it's time to stop.

title: Don't Start Now
summary: I've moved on — don't show up now trying to restart.

title: Flowers
themes: doing for herself what he wouldn't
summary: I can buy myself flowers — I don't need you to.

title: People
summary: Did anyone actually check on me? I've been drinking through it alone.

title: Rockabye
summary: Rockabye, baby — I'll do whatever it takes to keep you safe.

title: Never Say Never
summary: I'll never say never — I'll keep getting back up.

title: Blank Space
summary: Got a blank space with your name on it — this'll be beautiful, or a nightmare.

title: Let Me Down Slowly
summary: If you're going to leave me — let me down slowly.

title: Attention
themes: ex who wants attention not love
summary: You just want my attention — you don't actually want me.

title: We Don't Talk Anymore
summary: We used to talk about everything — now we don't talk at all.

title: The Heart Wants What It Wants
summary: I know it's bad for me — but the heart wants what it wants.

title: Same Old Love
summary: I've heard this same old love a million times — I'm done.

title: Yummy
summary: You've got that yummy — I'll come running.

title: Lose You To Love Me
themes: needing to lose someone to find yourself
summary: I had to lose you to love me — and I finally did.

title: You Belong With Me
summary: You belong with me — you just haven't figured it out yet.

title: Perfect
themes: being the wrong kind of guy
not the guy you take home
summary: I'm not the perfect boyfriend — but I'm perfect for tonight.

title: Steal My Girl
summary: She's been mine since sixteen — everyone wants to steal her.

title: Sugar
summary: I need your love like sugar — right now, don't make me wait.

title: Hymn for the Weekend
summary: You're my angel-drug — pour a symphony, shoot us across the sky.

title: Sajni
translation: O beloved, how do the days and nights pass / how do I speak to you, your memory haunts me / how heavy the clouds gather / your memory keeps torturing me.
summary: How am I supposed to get through the day when I can't stop remembering you?

title: Allah Waariyan
translation: Own people are hurt, strangers are hurt / friends may not be / dreams break, promises break / a heart shouldn't / even if God is upset, may friends never be.
summary: May God protect our friendship above everything else.

title: Tu Jaane Na
artist: Atif Aslam (Ajab Prem Ki Ghazab Kahani)
translation: How to say why I love you, dear / matters of the heart, see the eyes of language explain to you / you don't know, dear, you don't know / even meeting we didn't meet / didn't get to join with you / you don't know.
summary: I love you and you don't know — and I don't know how to say it.
